name: Set Dosa
steps: Wash and soak the rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Soak the poha briefly, then grind everything with the measured water to a smooth, slightly thick batter.
Cover loosely and ferment overnight until light and bubbly. Add salt gently; do not beat out all the air. The batter should fall slowly from a ladle, unlike thin rava-dosa batter.
Heat a griddle on medium and brush lightly with oil. Pour a small ladleful for each dosa and let it settle into a thick 10–12 cm round without spreading it paper-thin.
Cover for about 2 minutes until many holes form and the top sets. Flip briefly for 30–45 seconds, keeping the dosa pale, soft and spongy; repeat to make twelve small dosas.
Warm the prepared vegetable sagu. Serve three dosas per person with a quarter of the sagu and coconut chutney, while the dosas are still pillowy.
tips: Set dosa should stay thick and soft, with many steam holes; do not flatten it into a crisp plain dosa.
passiveTime: Soak for 5 hours and ferment the batter overnight.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
